'''Ropagi''' was the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Ropagi system/Legends|Ropagi system]].

==Description==
Ropagi was a [[Color/Legends|yellow-white]] Type-F main sequence [[Star/Legends|star]].<ref name="TEA" /> It marked one end of the [[Kira Run]], the other one being [[Lazerian (star)|Lazerian]].<ref name="RII" />
